# GameTime Sports Systems

> Family-owned supplier of baseball and softball field materials since 2008: infield conditioners, infield mixes, mound clay, clay bricks, warning track material and field marking powder and paint. Sold by written quote, direct or through distributors in 23 US states. Phone 800.520.0512.

## Products
- [All products](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/): the full line by category
- [GameTime Pro infield conditioner](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-pro/): calcined clay conditioner for moisture control and reduced compaction
- [GameTime Stadium Red](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-stadium-red/): burgundy red calcined clay conditioner; 2.25 tons covers 1,000 sq ft at 1 inch
- [GameTime H2O/Abzorb](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-h2o-abzorb/): calcined clay drying agent for puddles and mud
- [GameTime Infield Mixes](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-infield-mixes/): red, tan and custom infield mixes
- [GameTime Pitcher's Mound Clay](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-mound-clay/): one 50 lb bag covers 4 sq ft at 1 inch
- [GameTime Clay Bricks](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-clay-bricks/): 4 x 8 x 2.5 inch unfired clay bricks, 320 per pallet
- [GameTime Warning Track Material](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-warning-track-material/): dry screened red shale
- [GameTime White Strip field marking powder](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-white-strip-field-marking-powder/): non-caustic ground calcium carbonate
- [GameTime Stripe-It bulk field paint](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-stripe-it-bulk-paint/): water-based paint in 5 gallon pails
- [GameTime Stripe-It aerosol field paint](https://gametimesportssystems.com/products/gametime-stripe-it-spray-paint/): water-based aerosol marking paint
